description: This file defines the Security interface for authorization-related methods within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes method signatures for permissions checking, role validation, and cache management related to user security contexts.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Interface defining methods for authorization, permission checks, and cache clearing within OFBiz's security module.

methods.name: findUserLoginSecurityGroupByUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves security groups for a user login ID using cache. Deprecated.

methods.name: securityGroupPermissionExists
methods.description: Checks if a security permission exists for a group ID and permission name. Deprecated.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user session or a specific user login has a specified permission.

methods.name: hasEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user session or a specific user login has permission on a particular entity/action.

methods.name: hasRolePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific role permission within an application context, optionally validating against a role list or session.

methods.name: clearUserData
methods.description: Clears cached data related to a specific user login, typically upon logout.
